description:
HPS Real Estate are delighted to bring to the market No. 49 Jairdin Drive, a spacious four-bedroom, three-bathroom semi-detached home situated in the established residential development of Jairdin Drive, Farranalynch, Loughrea.

Offering approximately 1,122 sq. ft. (104 sq. m.) of accommodation over two floors, this well-proportioned property provides excellent space for modern family living and benefits from generous living accommodation, a large kitchen/dining room, four bedrooms and three bathrooms.

On entering the property, a welcoming hallway leads through to the main living accommodation. The generously proportioned sitting room is a bright and comfortable space, featuring attractive timber flooring and a traditional fireplace with an ornate surround, creating a lovely focal point to the room.

To the rear of the property is the exceptionally spacious kitchen/dining room, which provides an excellent heart to the home. The kitchen offers an extensive range of fitted wall and floor units, generous worktop space and integrated cooking facilities, while the adjoining dining area provides ample room for a large family dining table. French doors open directly onto the rear garden/courtyard, allowing plenty of natural light into the room and providing easy access to the outdoor space.

A separate utility/laundry room is located off the kitchen, providing useful additional storage and household space, while a guest WC completes the accommodation at ground floor level.

Upstairs, the property provides four well-proportioned bedrooms, making it particularly well suited to family living, working from home or those requiring additional guest accommodation. The bedrooms are complemented by two bathrooms, providing excellent convenience for a busy household.

Externally, the property benefits from a private front driveway providing off-street parking, while to the rear is a generous enclosed paved courtyard/garden area, offering a low-maintenance outdoor space with excellent potential for outdoor dining, entertaining or family use. The rear also benefits from additional storage/outbuilding accommodation.

Jairdin Drive is a well-established residential development situated along the Dublin Road in Loughrea. The property is conveniently positioned for access to the town centre and the wide range of amenities available locally, including shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, schools, sporting facilities and recreational amenities. Loughrea is also well positioned for commuters, with convenient access to the M6 motorway, while regular bus services connect the town with Galway City.

Families are well catered for locally, with primary schools including St. Ita's National School, St. Brendan's National School and Gaelscoil Riabhach, while St. Raphael's College and St. Brigid's College provide secondary education in the town.

For leisure and recreation, Loughrea offers access to Loughrea Lake, the Long Point area, walking routes, sporting clubs and a range of local amenities, making it an attractive location for families and those looking for the convenience of town living while remaining within easy reach of Galway City.

Overall, No. 49 Jairdin Drive represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a substantial four-bedroom home in an established and convenient Loughrea location. Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the generous accommodation and potential this property has to offer.
